checked: Act of July 15, 1870, ch. 296, 16 Stat. 335, 359 (govinfo): $25,000 to collect bands of Kickapoo or other Indians roving on the borders of Texas and Mexico and locate and subsist them in the Indian Territory.

ICC Docket 318 findings (pointer 1010) and final judgment (pointer 1926), June 11, 1969: 206,466 acres, about 184,300 ceded by the agreement of September 9, 1891; $64,650 cash, $215,000 appropriated 1908, total $279,650 stated by the Commission; title as of October 1, 1874 as a gratuity; McLoud council August 3, 1968, vote 38 to 7; compromise $273,250.
The compromise concerns the 1891 cession, recorded in cession-1893-03-03-kickapoo, not this appropriation act.
